vatBasis: Public Printful EU catalog prices shown incl. VAT where available.
shippingPolicy: Initial AFCNDXS phase: charge shipping separately / confirm on request. Shipping figures below are current public EU-facing proxies, not a final Barcelona checkout quote.
caveats: Printful states product prices vary by fulfillment location, technique, placement, color, size, taxes and shipping.
Posters and notebooks can ship separately from mixed orders; do not assume one combined shipping charge.
Final PVP must be checked again against an actual Barcelona checkout quote before publication.

items.label: POSTCARD · STANDARD

items.label: T-SHIRT · CREATOR 2.0

items.label: T-SHIRT · COMFORT COLORS 1717

items.label: SWEATSHIRT · RADDLER 2.0

items.label: NOTEBOOK · SPIRAL

items.positioning: Premium notebook tier; physical sample needed before deciding whether both notebook formats are necessary.
